definingProposition: Make Nigeria's digital systems work together without surrendering statutory authority, operational continuity, evidentiary integrity, or institutional independence.

industries.name: Payments and Money Movement
industries.concreteFailureMode: Single-leg transfers work, but asynchronous network timeouts leave operations in ambiguous states risking double-debits on retry, and card rails are unviable for sub-cent machine/agent transactions.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Deterministic operation state machines preserving UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT states, idempotent reference locks, and HTTP 402 micro-settlement verification schemas.

industries.name: Banking, Lending and Open Finance
industries.concreteFailureMode: Bank cash-flow APIs are siloed from pending High Court debt suits, Mareva injunctions, corporate solvency filings, and land title encumbrances.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Multi-sector ClearAm consent envelopes joining CBN Open Banking feeds with court litigation clearance and CAC status under a single NDPA-compliant purpose token.

industries.name: Insurance and Micro-Claims
industries.concreteFailureMode: Digital policy issuance exists, but hospital discharge summaries, police accident extracts, and death certificates circulate as unverified scans vulnerable to fraud and Section 84 admissibility rejection.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Hardware-signed SureEvidence claim attestations binding clinical and incident records to Ed25519 issuer seals.

industries.name: Investment, Capital Markets and Funds
industries.concreteFailureMode: Listed retail equities are digitized, but unlisted MSME debt notes, sub-national municipal bonds, and infrastructure concession instruments lack standardized programmatic issuance and lien verification.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Machine-readable debt covenant schemas and cryptographic lien-registry verification contracts.

industries.name: Tax, e-Invoicing and Treasury IGR
industries.concreteFailureMode: 36 State IRS collection portals are fragmented; public registries (courts, land bureaus) face audit liability when private vendors escrow statutory fees instead of direct treasury pass-through.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Section 121(3) CFRN zero-escrow split-routing specification and cryptographically signed fiscal receipt schemas.

industries.name: Accounting, ERP and Corporate Treasury
industries.concreteFailureMode: SME accounting software lacks native Nigerian statutory tax-code mappings (WHT, VAT splits, Stamp Duty) and automated e-invoice reconciliation.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Canonical Nigerian Fiscal Chart-of-Accounts JSON schema and automated tax-rule policy modules.

industries.name: Identity, Biometrics and KYB/KYC
industries.concreteFailureMode: Commercial KYC aggregators act as thin wrappers that fail when agency portals drop, expose raw PII unnecessarily, and lack statutory professional roll verification (NBA SCN, MDCN, COREN).

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Zero-knowledge identity and professional roll attestation credentials preventing raw NIN/BVN over-retention under NDPA 2023.

industries.name: Employment, Payroll and Pensions
industries.concreteFailureMode: Payroll calculation works, but statutory PAYE tax, pension (RSA), and housing deductions require fragmented manual uploads across 36 different state portals.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Unified multi-agency statutory remittance payload routing PENCOM, NHF, and state PAYE atomically.

industries.name: Logistics, Courier and Haulage
industries.concreteFailureMode: Urban courier aggregators work, but inter-state heavy haulage lacks standardized electronic waybills, offline rural handoff proofs, and Section 84 admissible loss/damage evidence.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Offline-capable geo-stamped proof-of-delivery credentials and unified fulfillment state schemas.

industries.name: Cross-Border Trade, Customs and Ports
industries.concreteFailureMode: Exporters and clearing agents re-key identical manifest data across NCS, SON, NAFDAC, and terminal operators, causing port demurrage and ECOWAS ETLS border delays.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Signed multi-agency cargo event chain linking bill-of-lading, regulatory certificates, and terminal release tokens.

industries.name: Retail and Open Digital Commerce
industries.concreteFailureMode: Centralized marketplaces charge 15–25% commissions and lock merchant catalogs and reputation inside closed silos.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Unbundled catalog discovery, order negotiation, and fulfillment protocols allowing any buyer app to transact with any merchant.

industries.name: Energy, Smart Grids and Utilities
industries.concreteFailureMode: Prepaid vending APIs exist, but DisCo feeder telemetry, mini-grid generation data, and smart-meter consumption logs lack open interoperability and tamper-evident billing audit trails.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Standardized smart-meter telemetry and automated DisCo/mini-grid settlement verification schemas.

industries.name: Connected Vehicles and Fleets
industries.concreteFailureMode: Commercial fleet GPS data is locked in proprietary hardware vendors; interstate cargo manifests and roadworthiness certificates cannot be verified offline at highway checkpoints.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Offline-verifiable QR transit manifests and standardized fleet telemetry event schemas.

industries.name: Mobility, Mass Transit and Ticketing
industries.concreteFailureMode: Transit smartcards are closed-loop per state/operator; commuters cannot book or clear single-ticket multi-modal journeys across BRT, rail, and inland waterways.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Interoperable transit fare clearing and signed QR ticket validation protocol.

industries.name: Agriculture, Inputs and Food Security
industries.concreteFailureMode: Smallholder farmers lack standardized farm-boundary polygons, and electronic warehouse receipts lack cryptographic title provenance accepted by commercial banks for inventory credit.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Offline-capturable smallholder geopolygon schema and Section 84 signed electronic warehouse receipt credentials.

industries.name: Manufacturing and Industrial IoT
statutoryStewards: Federal Ministry of Industry, Trade & Investment
industries.concreteFailureMode: Factory quality-control and effluent/emissions sensors are air-gapped; regulators and supply-chain buyers lack tamper-evident telemetry proving batch quality or environmental compliance.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Hardware-signed edge telemetry attestation schema for industrial quality and NESREA environmental audit logs.

industries.name: Construction, Land and Property Titles
industries.concreteFailureMode: 30+ state deeds registries remain paper-based; even in digitized states, land searches do not cross-check active High Court lis pendens caveats, causing fraudulent double-sales.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Unified cadastral parcel AST bridging State Deeds Registries with court lis pendens caveats and s. 84 verified search certificates.

industries.name: Climate, Weather and Environmental Data
industries.concreteFailureMode: Hyper-local ground weather and river-gauge telemetry is published in static PDF bulletins rather than machine-readable geo-alert feeds for flood early warning and parametric crop insurance.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Machine-readable CAP (Common Alerting Protocol) and hyper-local agro-meteorological JSON telemetry schema.

industries.name: Healthcare, EMRs and e-Prescriptions
industries.concreteFailureMode: Patient medical histories are trapped inside individual hospital EMRs; transferring referrals or verifying prescriptions across facilities lacks patient-controlled NDPA consent and HL7 FHIR standardization.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Clean-room Nigerian HL7 FHIR patient summary profile governed by ClearAm patient consent tokens.

industries.name: Education, Credentials and Skilling
industries.concreteFailureMode: University transcripts and degree verifications take months of manual postal/email verification; employers and foreign institutions lack cryptographic W3C Verifiable Credentials.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: W3C Verifiable Credential profile for Nigerian university degrees, NYSC discharge certificates, and WAEC/NECO records.

industries.name: Judiciary, Justice and Legal Practice
industries.concreteFailureMode: 30+ State High Courts and 1,000+ Magistracies are offline; scanned PDFs face Section 84 admissibility challenges; namesake counsel cause homonym attribution errors; lawyer rankings violate RPC 2023 Rule 39.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Offline-first <35 KB court registry kernel, Ed25519 s.84 CTC seals, neutral 13-code procedural disposition taxonomy, and bi-temporal statutory ASTs.

industries.name: Travel, Tourism and Hospitality
industries.concreteFailureMode: Hotel guest identity check-in relies on unverified physical photocopies, and domestic tour/transport operators lack multi-party escrow settlement.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Privacy-preserving guest check-in verification token and multi-vendor itinerary settlement schema.

industries.name: Food Service and Hyperlocal Delivery
industries.concreteFailureMode: Independent kitchens face 25–30% aggregator platform fees and cannot broadcast live inventory across competing last-mile rider networks.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Open menu syndication and hyperlocal rider dispatch contract decoupling kitchen catalogs from single delivery apps.

industries.name: Media, Creative Rights and Entertainment
industries.concreteFailureMode: Terrestrial broadcasters and venues lack automated, tamper-evident airplay logging, causing massive royalty disputes and copyright infringement litigation.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Cryptographic media fingerprint attestation and automated royalty split-settlement ledger schema.

industries.name: Communications and Telecom Network APIs
industries.concreteFailureMode: SMS/USSD aggregators exist, but carrier-level network capabilities (SIM-swap velocity, silent number verification, device roaming status) lack unified open interfaces across all 4 Nigerian MNOs.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Normalized cross-MNO carrier verification and asynchronous delivery-receipt state contracts.

industries.name: Network Intelligence and Anti-Fraud
industries.concreteFailureMode: Banks and fintechs cannot share real-time mule-account and SIM-swap fraud signals across institutions without breaching NDPA 2023 customer confidentiality.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Zero-knowledge hashed fraud-signal exchange schema compliant with NDPA statutory public-interest exemptions.

industries.name: AI and Nigerian Indigenous Languages
industries.concreteFailureMode: General NLP models exist for Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, and Pidgin, but lack deterministic statutory, judicial, and medical glossaries with mandatory human semantic review flags.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Versioned 5-locale (en-NG, ha-NG, yo-NG, ig-NG, pcm-NG) statutory and civic terminology ASTs with semantic approval gates.

industries.name: Geospatial, Maps and Digital Addressing
industries.concreteFailureMode: Informal settlements, rural farms, and new peri-urban layouts lack verifiable street addresses, blocking KYC address verification and last-mile delivery.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Offline-computable hierarchical grid-code addressing schema linked to State GIS cadastral boundaries.

industries.name: Security, Authentication and PKI Cryptography
industries.concreteFailureMode: State ministries and courts cannot afford proprietary foreign HSMs, leaving digital documents unsigned or signed with insecure passwords rather than hardware-backed keys.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: FIDO2 WebAuthn and Ed25519 public-key pinning specification for low-cost hardware security keys.

industries.name: Developer Infrastructure, Testing and Chaos Simulation
industries.concreteFailureMode: Provider sandboxes (e.g., Paystack/Termii test modes) always return instant HTTP 200 success, leaving developer apps untested against real-world delayed callbacks, reversals, and 2G drops.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Executable Gherkin BDD failure-recovery scenario packs and CLI conformance runner (`@nigeriastack/conformance-cli`).

industries.name: Data Products, Statutory ASTs and Search
statutoryStewards: National Assembly / State Houses of Assembly
industries.concreteFailureMode: Nigerian statutes, gazettes, and regulatory circulars are published as unindexed PDFs without point-in-time amendment history or cryptographic provenance.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Bi-temporal Akoma Ntoso 3.0 XML/JSON statutory tree standard (`urn:lex:ng:*`) with verbatim span bounding-box grounding.

industries.name: Autonomous Agent Governance and MCP Safety
industries.concreteFailureMode: Community MCP tools suffer from prompt-injection flaws, lack NDPA 2023 s. 37 human-oversight gates, and have no standardized micro-settlement or delegation mandate.

nigeriaStackIntervention.deliverable: Read-only default MCP tool profiles, cryptographic human countersignatures, and two-phase HTTP 402 escrow rules.
